encoder: Claude Sonnet 5.5, a single agent working alone from the brief (iaw-isl)
display_name: Income Support Law 5741-1980 (Israel): the whole Law with a seat layer
seat: A person or family living in Israel whose means fall short of the minimum the Income Support Law sets, asking whether they are entitled to an income-support allowance, how much and from when, what they must do to keep it, what can reduce or stop it, and what they can be made to repay.

scope.encoded: Every section, subsection, paragraph, schedule item, table row and defined term of the consolidated text, each with exactly one disposition in the coverage table in NOTES.md: encoded 307, fork 46, inert (1: not operative) 69, inert (2: machinery) 20, repealed or blank 14; 456 rows covering all 509 non-blank lines of the text.
scope.not_encoded: The Minister's regulations, and the Insurance Law and the other Acts the Law points at (none is in the sources): every rule that depends on them takes an input or answers NOTHING. Machinery rows (regulation-making powers, amendments of other Acts, savings, commencement) are inert with reason 2.
scope.layers: Layer 1: nine modules of the Law with eight test files. Layer 2: isl-seat.l4 (99 questions, 14 groups) and isl-cases-seat.l4 (404 cases).

edition.text: Hebrew Wikisource consolidated working text of the Income Support Law, 5741-1980, as raw MediaWiki source
edition.note: Unofficial consolidation; the official version is the Reshumot publication (ס״ח תשמ״א, 30; further publication ס״ח תשמ״א, 77) with every amending Act. Not a historical vintage.
